A uniform h=O(sqrt n) logarithmic expansion of the exact binomial ratio yields 4(1-2t^2)e^{-t^2}. Embedded verify.py independently exhausts 82,499 Catalan trees and verifies 45,024 assertions, which are supporting finite checks and not infinite proof.

value.rationale: A root’s offspring and the full generation-width profile are canonical tree observables. The result gives a complete exact depth-by-depth dependence sign classification, a discrete zero law n=2h^2+h-1, and a nontrivial continuum covariance 4(1-2t^2)e^{-t^2}. This resolves a motivated size-conditioning question and goes beyond marginal root degree or generation-width formulas.
